message: The SpaceX API, revived by Pipeworx. api.spacexdata.com was archived in June 2026 and its origin is offline; these routes serve the same datasets rebuilt from the ORIGINAL upstream sources (Launch Library 2 + space-track.org), synced 4x daily — so the data is current again, not frozen.
compatibility: Route paths mirror the old v4 API; response schemas are simplified rebuilds, not byte-identical v4. Field-level differences are documented at the docs URL.
